annotations.text:
Direction: Airlight. Warm-white canvas, light sidebar (dark one is gone), a single indigo accent, Manrope type, real SVG icons. Everything else stays neutral so the status colors do the talking.
Try the accent chip above the Dashboard to test other hues.

One status language everywhere:
green = active / paid / reimbursed / finalized
amber = pending / awaiting / partial
red = rejected / overdue / deductions
blue = submitted / in review / in pipeline
gray = inactive / any draft / on hold
Money: green credit (+), red debit (−), amber balance.
Text on tints uses the darker shade of each family for AA contrast.
Low-fi alternate: same system with a teal accent. Pick a hue and I will apply the winning palette across the app's CSS tokens.
